note: Grow the edit-song library from legit, redistributable sources only (Internet Archive Creative Commons / public domain: CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA). Do not rip commercial tracks from YouTube, Spotify, or SoundCloud. Ingest runs on GitHub Actions (scripts/ingest_music.py), not on a laptop. mp3s are loudnormed, analysed (BPM/drop/energy), uploaded to the 'music' release, and indexed in music/library.json. Same-song repeat window stays 8 videos.
